title: Catalogue brand logos: assets and code verified
summary: Add ten catalogue brand logos and show compact logos on home, catalogue, recommendations, search and wishlist cards.

changes.detail: Bundle Lenovo, Sony, Jordan, Baasploa, GENAI, Kemei, Ellesse, Kangol, Joma and Emporio Armani logos sourced from official brand sites or Simple Icons. Record source attribution.

Render compact accessible logos on product, search and wishlist cards; keep category text when brand is absent. Preserve registry overrides and offline fallback. Remove recurring registry polling now that the mark is rendered on many cards.

validation.name: Asset review
validation.detail: Visually inspected all ten added logos on white surfaces. Converted white Kemei/Baasploa artwork to black with alpha preserved; selected the main Joma mark from the official header.

validation.name: Typecheck, lint and tests
validation.detail: Mobile typecheck and ESLint for all four changed components passed. Eight brand/history tests passed.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: ATMPC remains a text fallback because no authentic logo source was verified. Device layout and interactions were not tested. No deployment.
